packet.title: Calendars and languages in the formatting functions (implementation)

item.p: F&O 4.0, 9.9.4.8 (the calendars: AD, ISO, AH, AME, AM, AP, AS, BE, CB, CE, CL, CS, EE, FE, JE, KE, KY, ME, MS, NS, OS, RS, SE, SH, SS, TE, VE, VS) and the language argument of the date formatting functions (month, day and era names);
CLDR (Unicode License v3) for names, ordinals and spell-out rules.
QT4: language de 16, it 2, fr 1, default-language fr-CA 1, fn-format-integer-CLDR 4;
XT40: languages_for_numbering de 6, it 1 and fr 1, ICU_spellout 3, ordinal_scheme_name 3;
other cases in fn-format-date (13 not run) and fn-format-integer (15 not run).
Replaces: in src/format_date.c and src/function_library_format_date.c, the fallback markers [Language: en] and [Calendar: AD] (); and the English-only words of src/format.c.

a language table (glossary ) per language: month and day names and abbreviations, eras, ordinal suffixes and spell-out rules, as data the existing engines read. The proposed set is en, de, fr, it, es and nl (owner question 5);

calendar conversion as one step before formatting. The arithmetic calendars are BE, JE (eras over Gregorian), OS (Julian) and AH (tabular Islamic). The others keep the fallback marker, which F&O allows.
After: 7.16 (shared src/format_date.c) and 7.15b (shared CLDR data and tooling).
Owns: new src/language_tables.c (generated by a new tools/generate-language-tables.py) and src/calendar.c; the language hunks of src/format.c and src/format_date.c.
Size: 5–15 KB plus 3–6 KB per language.

Gate: ≥ 75 % of the 38 named cases, and no format-date or format-integer case lost. Done 2026-10-19 (), gate met: the 38 named cases all run and pass (QT4 language de 16, it 2, fr 1, default-language fr-CA 1, of them fn-format-integer-CLDR 4; XT40 languages_for_numbering de 6, it 1, fr 1, ICU_spellout 3, ordinal_scheme_name 3); fn-format-date XQ40 137 of 138 (not run 13 to 1), fn-format-integer 94 (not run 15 to 8: numbering sequences), none lost. CLDR files from the host ('s way, no generated tables): the optional feature localization, src/cldr.c shared with the collation tailorings, src/language_table.c, src/spell_out.c (RBNF), src/calendar.c (BE, JE, OS, AH). sxml.wasm +4,920 bytes, sxml-full.wasm +32,103, the CLI +366,194 (embedded names).
